name: dev.knowapi/data
title: KnowAPI
description: No API? KnowAPI: verified, cited public data for AI agents, and any missing data built on request.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: List the public data APIs, optionally filtered by a search term. Returns each API id, what it covers, its query parameters, up to 3 real sample records (current data, free to inspect before getting a key or paying), and its dashboard link. If nothing matches, we start building an API for your search right away and return building.request_id: it is usually ready in 5 to 10 minutes (check_request).

query.description: Optional search text, e.g. "recall" or "drug shortage".

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Issue a free API key for one API (keys are per API; the monthly free calls are shared by all your keys). Keep it and reuse it.

tools.name: query_api
tools.description: Query a directory API with its key. Pass filters as params (see the API's query parameters from search_apis). Returns data plus provenance, coverage and quality warnings. A call returns up to 50 records; for more, set limit to up to 500 (10x the call price) or up to 3,000 (60x), paid from the key's credit; you pay only for records returned (see options from search_apis or get_plans; fast-changing feeds also offer live=true: data re-read just before answering, 5x the call price).

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Describe data you need (10-500 characters). We research public sources: if one may be used, it becomes an API in the directory, usually within 5 to 10 minutes (poll check_request every couple of minutes). If it takes longer, the status says so and may offer alternatives that can be built right away. The request is listed publicly.

description.description: What data, for where, how fresh. E.g. "Daily list of FDA drug shortages with status and company".

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Status of a request from request_data (a new API usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; poll every couple of minutes). stage is researching, building, ready (builds[] has the api_id to query), or in_progress (we are still building it; check back later). in_progress may list alternatives that can be built right away.

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: Download every record of a dataset API (up to 3,000) as JSON in one go. Offered on datasets with more than 50 records; priced like a call returning that many records (see options.full_export), paid from the key's credit. Without enough credit it returns the price and how to pay (x402 at full_export_url, or add credit).

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Get told when new records matching your filters appear in a dataset API (e.g. new recalls for a brand, new outages in a county). Checks after every refresh of the source; charged one call price per delivery (up to 50 new records), from the key's free calls or credit. Without webhook_url, deliveries wait in an inbox: read them with check_alerts.

api_key.description: Key from get_api_key for this API.

params.description: Filters, same as query parameters, e.g. {"state":"CA"}.

webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL to receive signed POSTs.

tools.name: check_alerts
tools.description: New records delivered by your alerts since the last check (marked as read). Use the same key you created the alerts with.

tools.name: screen_entity
tools.description: Check a company or person against US sanctions (OFAC SDN and other Treasury lists), Commerce BIS Entity/Denied/Unverified lists, State Department ITAR and nonproliferation lists, and the HHS OIG healthcare exclusion list. Returns strong/possible matches with the official source of each, and which lists were checked when. Needs a key for the screening API (get_api_key with its api_id from search_apis "compliance"); $0.10 per check after free checks, or included in a monthly plan.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Pricing for a directory API: the price per call after the free calls (shared across all your keys), and the add-ons available for this feed with their prices (per call when used, or per export). No subscription: pay per call from prepaid credit on your key, or with x402 when a call returns 402. Monthly plans (compliance checks + data calls + monitored names): GET /v1/plans, buy with POST /v1/plans/buy?plan=starter|pro|business and your key. Cheapest for agents: top up a key once with x402 (POST /v1/credits/topup?usd=1, 5 or 20 with the key) and calls draw from that credit.
